items.summary: Approve the three execution-control themes only as updates to existing work items. They are technically feasible, isolated from site production, reversible, and measurable with existing telemetry. Do not create duplicate work items, change_requests, telemetry, schedules, permissions, credentials, spend, or production behavior. Reconcile approved work only after checking queued, active, deployed, cancelled, and failed records; document deduplication and routing controls before implementation; preserve unknown revenue, cost, margin, incrementality, causal lift, and operational-health fields. Keep gated launches private and continue existing containment and measurement work.

The proposed plan is safe to enter the existing queue as bounded work-item updates. Implementation effort is limited to record reconciliation, control specification, and—only after isolated review—a small deduplication or routing change with focused validation and rollback. No new production implementation is justified while the scorecard reports no unblocked candidate and existing failures and measurement backlog remain active.

Deployment-to-measurement handoff standardization is approved as read-only evidence work using only available impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, and site-attributed commission. Do not infer revenue, ROI, margin, incrementality, causal lift, or unavailable cost data. Keep launch gates unchanged.
